title: International Postgraduate in Business Administration (Level 7)
description: Explore international business management, leadership dynamics, and marketing practices with our International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Business Administration, designed to equip learners with the skills to thrive in a competitive international market.
longDescription: The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Business Administration offers a comprehensive exploration of global business management, advanced research practices, and leadership dynamics. This program is designed to equip professionals with the skills to excel in international business. Students will gain practical insights and theoretical knowledge essential for navigating and succeeding in a competitive global market. Focusing on practical experience, the course goes beyond traditional lectures, incorporating real-world scenarios, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning. This hands-on approach enables participants to apply new skills in a safe setting before transitioning to real-world situations. The IPGD in Business Administration can be completed in 9 months, offering a quick pathway to career advancement and new opportunities. The diploma combines theoretical concepts with practical experience, equipping learners to address complex operational issues confidently and effectively.
courseDetails: The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Business Administration aims to equip students with advanced managerial skills and strategic thinking required for leadership roles in a global business environment. The course fosters critical analysis and problem-solving abilities in crucial business areas such as finance, marketing, and operations. It also aims to develop a deep understanding of cross-cultural business practices and ethical decision-making. Course Details: Leadership and Organizational Behaviour: Delve into theories and practices to develop effective leadership strategies and comprehend the dynamics of organizational behaviour. International Business Management: Acquire knowledge on the complexities of global markets, cultural intricacies, and international trade strategies for successful business expansion. Strategic Financial Management: Enhance financial analysis, risk management, and strategic decision-making skills to drive sustainable business growth and optimize shareholder value. Business Research Methods: Delve into research techniques and methodologies vital for evidence-based decision-making and business innovation. Strategic Human Resource Management: Learn to align human resource strategies with organizational objectives, promoting employee engagement, talent development, and overall organizational effectiveness. Strategic Marketing: Understand how to leverage market analysis, branding, and marketing strategies to create a competitive edge and drive business growth in dynamic market environments. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in business administration and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

modules.title: LEADERSHIP AND ORGANIZATIONAL BEHAVIOUR
modules.summary: The Leadership and Organizational Behavior module is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of leadership and the principles of organizational behaviour. This module will explore the various leadership styles, traits, and behaviours that are necessary for effective leadership in modern organizations. Students will learn how to analyze and evaluate organizational structures and culture and the impact of these factors on employee motivation, job satisfaction, and performance. They will also examine team building dynamics and the importance of communication, conflict resolution, and decision-making in achieving organizational objectives.

modules.title: STRATEGIC FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: On completion of this unit, learners will have gained knowledge and understanding relating to planning the usage and management of a business organization’s financial resources. Learners will understand the importance of attaining business objectives and maximizing shareholder return. Learners will gain a working knowledge of business strategy design and the production of comprehensive business plans.
